mathematical_meanings: Left image: The shaded points constitute the solution region on one side of the linear boundary. Right image: The shading designates the entire area inside the equilateral triangle.
Rationales: The feature selects the solution half-plane of a linear inequality in the left image and selects a geometric area in the right image. The gray half-plane on the right side of the solid oblique boundary. The lavender triangle with three 2 in side labels.
